notes: INSIDE half of the Fenn Spark Lattice: a row of three small coils on a rail that charge up cyan one after another (frame 5 = all lit, white sparks between them, lamps green), power coupling, hatch. fire: the coils flash white and go dark. damaged: one coil unwound and dead, lamps dead, sparks; disabled: coils cold, a coil off its post. Barrel layer fenn_spark_lattice_barrel: an open lattice cage of thin struts round a crackling spark core, with three aerial whiskers; fire: sparks fly. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
